FY '27, definitely, the target is to take it to 3%, very much so.

Retail growth was healthy, and our same-store sales growth reached 22% in Q2 FY '26.
If you see the last couple of years, the growth in volumes as well as revenue is around 20% and volume growth is upwards of 25%.
Margins & costs: EBITDA margins stood at 3.03% in Q2 FY '26 and 3.31% for H1 FY '26.

Number two is, obviously, with that, we are hoping to achieve much better capacity utilizations and a separate marketing team, which will be focusing on niche products and focused only on the manufacturing part, that is Shankara Building Products Limited.
And thirdly, there is some urgent need to u pgrade some machinery etc., which we'll be taking on this CapEx in the next year.
Balance sheet & cash: Despite our expanding scale, we maintained strict control over working capital, which averaged to 30 days this quarter.

We have faced strong headwinds in the non -steel segment, largely due to the slowdown in construction activities in Karnataka, Kerala and Telangana.
This slowdown can be attributed to delays in government approvals, longer monsoons and slower money rotation.
